name: Foam Roller Side Lat Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with the roller across the muscular area just behind your lower armpit.
Extend your bottom arm overhead along the floor with your palm facing up and bend your knees slightly for stability.
Relax your torso weight gently into the roller while leaning slightly backward to deepen the stretch along your lat and side rib cage.
Hold the stretch with slow, steady breaths on one side, then switch sides.
tips: Keep the roller on the muscular area behind your armpit rather than pressing straight into the rib bones.
Support some weight with your feet so you can ease into the stretch.
